2521-03
Compare
Business Database Analyst
TVET
TVET scope is based on recognized occupational standards, with emphasis on practical components, psychomotor skills and exposure to training in the industry
Business Database Analyst uses data analysis to support and improve business decision-making. They collect, organise, and interpret data, manage and maintain databases, and produce reports and dashboards that provide insights into business performance and trends.
Tasks
Design, develop, construct, modify, and maintain database architecture and structures for business systems.
Analyse large datasets to identify business trends and insights.
Develop and optimise dashboards and reports for management use.
Automate data reporting processes to improve efficiency.
Collaborate with departments to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
Develop and implement data policies, standards, and documentation.
Present data-driven recommendations to stakeholders to support business decisions.
  • J
    Information and Communication
  • M
    Professional, Scientific and Technical Activities
  • IT-121-5:2011
    DATABASE PROGRAMMING (LEVEL 5) (Level 5)
  • 0611
    Information Technology and Information System
  • 0612
    Software Engineering
  • 0613
    Computer Science
  • 0614
    Computer Use
Skills
Basic
Attention to detail to ensure data accuracy and quality.
Critical thinking to evaluate information and form sound judgments.
Effective communication and stakeholder management to support decision-making.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data analysis and reporting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret complex data.
Specific
Competency in database performance optimisation, governance, security, and compliance.
Proficiency in analysing data and generating insights using data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Proficiency in applying programming skills in Python or R for data tasks.
Proficiency in designing, modelling, and managing business databases using SQL and systems such as MySQL and Oracle.
Proficiency in performing data warehousing and ETL processes.
Additional Info
QUALIFICATION
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

Welcome to the new version of the e-MASCO Portal.

This portal is currently being enhanced and upgraded by the Ministry of Human Resources (MOHR).

At present, the portal content is based on MASCO 2020, and the updated version is expected to be fully completed by the end of the fourth quarter of 2026. Some information and functions may still be in the testing phase.

We greatly appreciate any feedback and suggestions from users to help improve the features and content of this portal. Please share your views through the Feedback page.


Information on the Starting Basic Wages Guidelines

Please be informed that information on the Starting Basic Wages Guidelines, as announced in Budget 2027, will be made available on the e-MASCO portal beginning June 2027.

Users of the e-MASCO portal are kindly requested to take note of this announcement. Further updates will be published on the portal from time to time.

Your attention and cooperation are greatly appreciated.
